name: Mi-ko-ko-n
source:
The main character, a high school student, belongs to the "Miko" club, and enjoys his school life. One day, he picks up a stone statue of fox. Soon after he strokes its head, it turns into a girl. She is Misaki, a miko. She has lost all her memories except for her name, and she says she is going to disappear soon. Members of "Miko" club decides to do a ritual to save Misaki but....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主人公是一名高中生，隶属于‘巫女部’，享受着校园生活。一天，他捡到一尊狐狸石像，抚摸石像的头后不久，它竟变成了少女。少女名叫美咲，是一名巫女。她除了名字外失去了所有记忆，还说自己不久后就会消失。巫女部成员决定举行仪式拯救美咲，然而……

[摘自ErogeShop]
